    //==
    // # IArcLengthParameterized<TPoint>
    //
    // A curve measurable by arc length: ArcLength is the total length,
    // PointAtLength walks a distance from the start, ParameterAtLength converts a
    // distance to the canonical parameter. TPoint is the concrete point type
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arc_length).

    // The point at the start of the curve (zero distance travelled).
    ArcStartPoint(self: IArcLengthParameterized<$T>): $T
        => self.PointAtLength(0.0);
